name: Communication Mod
description: Provides structured event semantics, local non-LLM flow for multi-step Cursed Tome handling, and full run-lifecycle control: reports main menu / character select states, accepts set_ascension, starts the next run, and reports the death/victory settlement chain (including defeat and unlock screens) as clickable GAME_OVER states so automatic consecutive runs also trigger after a lost run. Also closes the card reward screen correctly after Singing Bowl selection. Also exposes pre-rolled chest contents (boss flag, gold reward, relic tier) on CHEST screens so clients can weigh opening against leaving under Cursed Key.
